name: organized-meta-wiring
description: Framework for wiring Meta APIs into a Cloudflare Worker: spinning up Meta Apps and system users, the self-refreshing 60-day token vault, Business Use Case rate limiting, and multi-ad-account fan-out. Covers Marketing API, Conversions API, Business Management, Catalog, Instagram, WhatsApp, Pages and Lead Ads, plus the Meta Ads CLI and the hosted Ads MCP server.
